cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. A fair result. Let's celebrate my cake's first prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you move yours under the judging light?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Lighting maintenance. We shouldn't let logistics overshadow flavour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was left in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful note for whoever organises next year's logistics.
